facts.fact: The Cyber Security Authority fined EY Ghana GH¢360,000 on 18 August 2026 under the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038), which it enforces through licensing of cybersecurity service providers.
The article refers to owners of Critical Information Infrastructure under Act 1038 as clients subject to the licensing rules, which treats such owners as a defined category.

note: Sanctions are not incidents handled or alerts issued, so no response fact.
